name: S-seeded products — S1 Actuation · full-depth · ProjectCentral NOW — day 2026-09-11 and its session flows (1/2)
description: Full-depth fan-out artifact for the Actuation product corpus, family: ProjectCentral NOW — day 2026-09-11 and its session flows (part 1 of 2). Companion to the wave-1 whole-first corpus-root journey production/s-products/actuation/sp-actuation.journey.json — the S1 record's own movement path (#0 → #5→0) — which this artifact extends with the remaining inventoried records. Every scene binds one material record from working/expression-corpus/P1-census-actuation.json (frozen-census-basis, 157 records), re-hashed from EpiLogos/Actuation git object storage at published origin/main 36bbf93b7896550f11186f6240b8f018208ab3b2 on 2026-09-21: each bound record is byte-identical to published main; records changed since the census freeze bind their current committed bytes with the delta noted in the binding record. Scene texts compress and quote the records' own headings, never invent claims; tints, formations and layout are declared craft (profiles/family-actuation). Admission: the essay's S register (T25 census, register episteme). Wave-2 fan-out — not a rival admission, not corpus rewrite.
